name: rook_invading_opponent_territory
description: The side to move has a rook on the opponent side of the board while the opponent has no rook on the side-to-move side.
source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'rook_invading_opponent_territory'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has a rook on the opponent side of the board while the opponent has no rook on the side-to-move side.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    stm_rooks = board.pieces(chess.ROOK, stm)
    opp_rooks = board.pieces(chess.ROOK, opp)
    
    def on_opponent_half(sq, color):
        rank = chess.square_rank(sq)
        return (color == chess.WHITE and rank >= 4) or (color == chess.BLACK and rank <= 3)
    
    stm_has = any(on_opponent_half(sq, stm) for sq in stm_rooks)
    opp_has = any(on_opponent_half(sq, opp) for sq in opp_rooks)
    
    return stm_has and not opp_has
